# Alerts and quotes

> [!NOTE]
> Note bodies stay default-colored; only the rail and title take the type hue.

> [!TIP]
> Tips can span several lines so wrapping gets exercised across widths.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Important information with `inline code` and a [link](https://example.com).

> [!WARNING]
> Warnings may contain lists:
>
> - first
> - second

> [!CAUTION]
> Caution: proceed carefully.

> A plain blockquote keeps the magenta rail.
> Multiple source lines flow together.

> [!FOO]
> Unknown types decline to plain quotes.

- > [!NOTE]
  > Alerts inside lists decline too.

> [!NOTE] with prose on the marker line declines.
